verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a client-side JavaScript UI framework, not a hosted service, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product. There is no vendor-run deployment to contrast with a self-hosted one. The MIT license and the npm/CDN distribution show openness, but they do not create a hosting axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
